purpose: Reviewable completion map and calculation inventory; not a new live task store
finish_line: Playable monkey game first; broader Chimera vision later
inspection_limits: Working files were read during active work, not captured as an atomic checkout. No runtime or physical tests rerun. Live DNA SQLite could not be opened read-only. No graph imports, claims, deployments or project modifications performed.
operational_owner: Existing GLM/controller and docs/THE_MASTER_LIST.md; reconcile newer operator instructions
status_policy: Task presence is not evidence of missing implementation. Every item must be reconciled to current receipts before dispatch. UNRECONCILED does not mean not built.
dependency_policy: Edges are prerequisites for final acceptance of the task; design/scaffolding can proceed earlier with controlled fixtures. No fixtures may be represented as real-packet acceptance.
feature_complete_policy: Core plus selected recommended_product tasks; conditional modernization only if the chosen playable build consumes it. No percent-complete or calendar forecast from task counts.

calculations.title: Frames, units and source correspondence
calculations.required_inputs: Source/target axes, landmarks, units, scale, transform conventions
calculations.calculation_or_contract: x_world=R x_local+t for rigid frames; distinguish scaling from rotations; compose/invert explicitly
calculations.output: One unambiguous frame chain and independently checked transforms
calculations.verification: Round-trip, handedness, landmark and independent-orientation checks
calculations.result_status: Inventory of required calculations/contracts; no new numerical result claimed

calculations.title: Mass inventory
calculations.required_inputs: Disjoint occupied material volumes, density with conditions, ownership
calculations.calculation_or_contract: m=integral rho dV; surface mass only if explicitly represented and not already volume-owned
calculations.output: Mass per body and counted total with excluded claims
calculations.verification: Analytic cells, disjoint ownership, shared-interface and recombination controls
calculations.result_status: Inventory of required calculations/contracts; no new numerical result claimed

calculations.title: Centre of mass and inertia
calculations.required_inputs: Geometry, rho, mass, authored frame
calculations.calculation_or_contract: c=(integral rho x dV)/m; I_c=integral rho[(r dot r)Id-r r^T]dV

calculations.verification: Independent quadrature, rotation covariance and parallel-axis recombination
calculations.result_status: Inventory of required calculations/contracts; no new numerical result claimed
